decision: Require an actual successful build of the complete installed binary set before publishing a new functional release, plus CI, security and updater discovery verification.
reason: The user explicitly required always checking builds after the 1.0.95 installer exposed compiler warnings and incomplete CI gates.
verification: The public build-entrypoint tests cover all ten installed binaries, compiler failure, cancellation and transcript errors. The lint parser must expose compiler reasons while rejecting a failed Cargo stream. A real locked release build is an additional publication gate.
not_tested: This rule alone provides no installed or physical-client acceptance.
